purpose: Dev-only lane that applies the parked 900-band migrations so pod provisioning has its tables in hushh-pda-dev. Never applied in UAT or production.
contract_note: These files MUST stay under db/migrations/parked/ and MUST NOT be added to release_migration_manifest.json. Both scripts/ops/verify_release_migration_contract.py and scripts/ops/db_migration_release_guard.py enumerate db/migrations/ with Path.is_file(), so the parked subdirectory is invisible to the repo-head and contract-version checks. Moving or manifesting these files would push the repo head from 131 to 904 and break the UAT and production schema contracts.
ordering_note: Numeric order is load-bearing: 902 creates an index on personal_agent_deletion_tombstones, which 900 creates, and 905, 906 and 907 alter personal_agent_registry, which 900 creates.
